henry.title: Bagpipe Drones, Ukulele and String Detective
henry.intro: Make a drone, then explore strings. (About 15 minutes.)
steps: 🎸 Hold C chord. Strum X X - X. That's a drone!
🎤 Sing Row, Row, Row Your Boat on top.
links: Video: What Is a Bagpipe? (1 minute)
Watch and listen for the drone and the tune.

handsOn.title: 🎸 Drone on your uke + String detective
steps: 1. Make your C chord (ring finger, A string, fret 3).
2. Strum X X - X slowly. Keep going. That is the drone.
3. Sing 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat'. C fits the whole song.
4. Guitar: pluck thickest to thinnest. Which is lowest?
5. Ukulele: pluck all 4. Thick or thin? High or low?
6. Press a guitar string halfway. Pluck. Higher or lower?
7. Pluck one string on each. Which is higher?
handsOn.look: Thick strings make low sounds. Short strings make high sounds. The drone is the steady sound underneath a tune.

worksheet: A drone is a: STEADY / QUICK sound. Circle one.
Pressing halfway makes the sound: HIGHER / LOWER
Which sounded higher overall? GUITAR / UKULELE

passage.text: 🎶 A bagpipe makes a steady hum called a drone. The tune plays on top of the drone.
🎸 Thick strings sound low. Thin strings sound high. A shorter string sounds higher.

words: a steady sound that keeps going
pull a string and let go
how high or low a sound is
henry.challenge: Keep your drone going while you sing the first line of 'Auld Lang Syne'. How many beats can you do?

frankie.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb with a Drone 🎹🐑
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: Bagpipes hum one steady sound called a drone. We'll do it on the piano, then make a tartan with socks or LEGO! (About 14 minutes.)
steps: 🎶 Play a second tune: Hot Cross Buns!
🧦 Lay a tartan with socks, paper strips or LEGO: red, blue, red, blue.

handsOn.title: 🎹 Piano drone song
steps: 👀 Look at the colored dots. They match your key stickers.
🤝 A grown-up holds the low 1 the whole time: the drone!
🧦 Tartan game: Lay 4 strips in a row: red, blue, red, blue. Lay 4 more across the top the same way. That's a tartan! (Use socks, paper strips, LEGO bricks or towels.)
👏🦶 Highland beat: Clap, clap, stomp! Do it 4 times while a grown-up hums the drone.
handsOn.look: Grown-up: the tune is 'Mary Had a Little Lamb'. Sing it together.
handsOn.q: Circle the pattern on your sheet.
